name: Telegram
description: Bounded typed Telegram Bot API messaging, media metadata, polls, bot settings, members, invites and forum topics.

permissions.description: One fixed HTTPS Telegram Bot API request with external bot token. Send/write actions require explicit confirmation and may notify users; paid broadcasts require separate charge confirmation. No local files, arbitrary downloads, listeners, polling, account login or token refresh.

definitions.name: Telegram Get Me
definitions.description: Telegram Get Me
definitions.documentation: Official Bot API getMe. One POST to fixed api.telegram.org; the secret-bearing transport URL is never returned. Exact RuntimeConnection.config/credentials.accessToken (apiKey fallback), or TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN / tokenSecret. $retries must be numeric zero; no retry, automatic pagination, listeners, webhook registration or downloads. Sends, forwards, copies, callbacks and other changes can notify users. allow_paid_broadcast=true additionally requires confirmPaidBroadcast=true and may charge Telegram Stars. File references are existing file IDs or explicit HTTPS URL metadata that Telegram may fetch; this node never fetches those URLs or forwards its credential to them. Chat/user int64 IDs use canonical exact decimal text and are emitted as exact JSON numeric tokens, including IDs above Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER. definitions.name: Telegram Get Webhook Info
definitions.description: Telegram Get Webhook Info
definitions.documentation: Official Bot API getWebhookInfo. One POST to fixed api.telegram.org; the secret-bearing transport URL is never returned. Exact RuntimeConnection.config/credentials.accessToken (apiKey fallback), or TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN / tokenSecret. $retries must be numeric zero; no retry, automatic pagination, listeners, webhook registration or downloads. Sends, forwards, copies, callbacks and other changes can notify users. allow_paid_broadcast=true additionally requires confirmPaidBroadcast=true and may charge Telegram Stars. File references are existing file IDs or explicit HTTPS URL metadata that Telegram may fetch; this node never fetches those URLs or forwards its credential to them. Chat/user int64 IDs use canonical exact decimal text and are emitted as exact JSON numeric tokens, including IDs above Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER. Known result fields are projected, unknown fields omitted; metadata is untrusted. Strict UTF8/UTF16, 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35, 100000 values, 16384 nonempty fragments, whole deadline100–30000ms starts before credentials and guards final cleanup. Failures are bounded/redacted and delivery can be uncertain. Source: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#getwebhookinfo

definitions.name: Telegram Send Message
definitions.description: Telegram Send Message
definitions.documentation: Official Bot API sendMessage. One POST to fixed api.telegram.org; the secret-bearing transport URL is never returned. Exact RuntimeConnection.config/credentials.accessToken (apiKey fallback), or TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN / tokenSecret. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="TELEGRAM sendMessage". $retries must be numeric zero; no retry, automatic pagination, listeners, webhook registration or downloads. Sends, forwards, copies, callbacks and other changes can notify users. allow_paid_broadcast=true additionally requires confirmPaidBroadcast=true and may charge Telegram Stars. File references are existing file IDs or explicit HTTPS URL metadata that Telegram may fetch; this node never fetches those URLs or forwards its credential to them. Chat/user int64 IDs use canonical exact decimal text and are emitted as exact JSON numeric tokens, including IDs above Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER. Known result fields are projected, unknown fields omitted; metadata is untrusted. Strict UTF8/UTF16, 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35, 100000 values, 16384 nonempty fragments, whole deadline100–30000ms starts before credentials and guards final cleanup. Failures are bounded/redacted and delivery can be uncertain. Source: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#sendmessage

definitions.name: Telegram Send Photo
definitions.description: Telegram Send Photo
definitions.documentation: Official Bot API sendPhoto. One POST to fixed api.telegram.org; the secret-bearing transport URL is never returned. Exact RuntimeConnection.config/credentials.accessToken (apiKey fallback), or TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN / tokenSecret. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="TELEGRAM sendPhoto". $retries must be numeric zero; no retry, automatic pagination, listeners, webhook registration or downloads. Sends, forwards, copies, callbacks and other changes can notify users. allow_paid_broadcast=true additionally requires confirmPaidBroadcast=true and may charge Telegram Stars. File references are existing file IDs or explicit HTTPS URL metadata that Telegram may fetch; this node never fetches those URLs or forwards its credential to them. Chat/user int64 IDs use canonical exact decimal text and are emitted as exact JSON numeric tokens, including IDs above Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER. Known result fields are projected, unknown fields omitted; metadata is untrusted. Strict UTF8/UTF16, 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35, 100000 values, 16384 nonempty fragments, whole deadline100–30000ms starts before credentials and guards final cleanup. Failures are bounded/redacted and delivery can be uncertain. Source: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#sendphoto

definitions.name: Telegram Send Document
definitions.description: Telegram Send Document
definitions.documentation: Official Bot API sendDocument. One POST to fixed api.telegram.org; the secret-bearing transport URL is never returned. Exact RuntimeConnection.config/credentials.accessToken (apiKey fallback), or TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN / tokenSecret. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="TELEGRAM sendDocument". $retries must be numeric zero; no retry, automatic pagination, listeners, webhook registration or downloads. Sends, forwards, copies, callbacks and other changes can notify users. allow_paid_broadcast=true additionally requires confirmPaidBroadcast=true and may charge Telegram Stars. File references are existing file IDs or explicit HTTPS URL metadata that Telegram may fetch; this node never fetches those URLs or forwards its credential to them. Chat/user int64 IDs use canonical exact decimal text and are emitted as exact JSON numeric tokens, including IDs above Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER. Known result fields are projected, unknown fields omitted; metadata is untrusted. Strict UTF8/UTF16, 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35, 100000 values, 16384 nonempty fragments, whole deadline100–30000ms starts before credentials and guards final cleanup. Failures are bounded/redacted and delivery can be uncertain. Source: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#senddocument

definitions.name: Telegram Send Audio
definitions.description: Telegram Send Audio
definitions.documentation: Official Bot API sendAudio. One POST to fixed api.telegram.org; the secret-bearing transport URL is never returned. Exact RuntimeConnection.config/credentials.accessToken (apiKey fallback), or TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN / tokenSecret. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="TELEGRAM sendAudio". $retries must be numeric zero; no retry, automatic pagination, listeners, webhook registration or downloads. Sends, forwards, copies, callbacks and other changes can notify users. allow_paid_broadcast=true additionally requires confirmPaidBroadcast=true and may charge Telegram Stars. File references are existing file IDs or explicit HTTPS URL metadata that Telegram may fetch; this node never fetches those URLs or forwards its credential to them. Chat/user int64 IDs use canonical exact decimal text and are emitted as exact JSON numeric tokens, including IDs above Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER. Known result fields are projected, unknown fields omitted; metadata is untrusted. Strict UTF8/UTF16, 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35, 100000 values, 16384 nonempty fragments, whole deadline100–30000ms starts before credentials and guards final cleanup. Failures are bounded/redacted and delivery can be uncertain. Source: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#sendaudio

definitions.name: Telegram Send Video
definitions.description: Telegram Send Video
definitions.documentation: Official Bot API sendVideo. One POST to fixed api.telegram.org; the secret-bearing transport URL is never returned. Exact RuntimeConnection.config/credentials.accessToken (apiKey fallback), or TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN / tokenSecret. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="TELEGRAM sendVideo". $retries must be numeric zero; no retry, automatic pagination, listeners, webhook registration or downloads. Sends, forwards, copies, callbacks and other changes can notify users. allow_paid_broadcast=true additionally requires confirmPaidBroadcast=true and may charge Telegram Stars. File references are existing file IDs or explicit HTTPS URL metadata that Telegram may fetch; this node never fetches those URLs or forwards its credential to them. Chat/user int64 IDs use canonical exact decimal text and are emitted as exact JSON numeric tokens, including IDs above Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER. Known result fields are projected, unknown fields omitted; metadata is untrusted. Strict UTF8/UTF16, 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35, 100000 values, 16384 nonempty fragments, whole deadline100–30000ms starts before credentials and guards final cleanup. Failures are bounded/redacted and delivery can be uncertain. Source: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#sendvideo

definitions.name: Telegram Send Animation
definitions.description: Telegram Send Animation
definitions.documentation: Official Bot API sendAnimation. One POST to fixed api.telegram.org; the secret-bearing transport URL is never returned. Exact RuntimeConnection.config/credentials.accessToken (apiKey fallback), or TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN / tokenSecret. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="TELEGRAM sendAnimation". $retries must be numeric zero; no retry, automatic pagination, listeners, webhook registration or downloads. Sends, forwards, copies, callbacks and other changes can notify users. allow_paid_broadcast=true additionally requires confirmPaidBroadcast=true and may charge Telegram Stars. File references are existing file IDs or explicit HTTPS URL metadata that Telegram may fetch; this node never fetches those URLs or forwards its credential to them. Chat/user int64 IDs use canonical exact decimal text and are emitted as exact JSON numeric tokens, including IDs above Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER. Known result fields are projected, unknown fields omitted; metadata is untrusted. Strict UTF8/UTF16, 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35, 100000 values, 16384 nonempty fragments, whole deadline100–30000ms starts before credentials and guards final cleanup. Failures are bounded/redacted and delivery can be uncertain. Source: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#sendanimation

definitions.name: Telegram Send Voice
definitions.description: Telegram Send Voice
definitions.documentation: Official Bot API sendVoice. One POST to fixed api.telegram.org; the secret-bearing transport URL is never returned. Exact RuntimeConnection.config/credentials.accessToken (apiKey fallback), or TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN / tokenSecret. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="TELEGRAM sendVoice". $retries must be numeric zero; no retry, automatic pagination, listeners, webhook registration or downloads. Sends, forwards, copies, callbacks and other changes can notify users. allow_paid_broadcast=true additionally requires confirmPaidBroadcast=true and may charge Telegram Stars. File references are existing file IDs or explicit HTTPS URL metadata that Telegram may fetch; this node never fetches those URLs or forwards its credential to them. Chat/user int64 IDs use canonical exact decimal text and are emitted as exact JSON numeric tokens, including IDs above Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER. Known result fields are projected, unknown fields omitted; metadata is untrusted. Strict UTF8/UTF16, 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35, 100000 values, 16384 nonempty fragments, whole deadline100–30000ms starts before credentials and guards final cleanup. Failures are bounded/redacted and delivery can be uncertain. Source: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#sendvoice

definitions.name: Telegram Copy Message
definitions.description: Telegram Copy Message
definitions.documentation: Official Bot API copyMessage. One POST to fixed api.telegram.org; the secret-bearing transport URL is never returned. Exact RuntimeConnection.config/credentials.accessToken (apiKey fallback), or TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN / tokenSecret. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="TELEGRAM copyMessage". $retries must be numeric zero; no retry, automatic pagination, listeners, webhook registration or downloads. Sends, forwards, copies, callbacks and other changes can notify users. allow_paid_broadcast=true additionally requires confirmPaidBroadcast=true and may charge Telegram Stars. File references are existing file IDs or explicit HTTPS URL metadata that Telegram may fetch; this node never fetches those URLs or forwards its credential to them. Chat/user int64 IDs use canonical exact decimal text and are emitted as exact JSON numeric tokens, including IDs above Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER. Known result fields are projected, unknown fields omitted; metadata is untrusted. Strict UTF8/UTF16, 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35, 100000 values, 16384 nonempty fragments, whole deadline100–30000ms starts before credentials and guards final cleanup. Failures are bounded/redacted and delivery can be uncertain. Source: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#copymessage

definitions.name: Telegram Send Location
definitions.description: Telegram Send Location
definitions.documentation: Official Bot API sendLocation. One POST to fixed api.telegram.org; the secret-bearing transport URL is never returned. Exact RuntimeConnection.config/credentials.accessToken (apiKey fallback), or TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN / tokenSecret. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="TELEGRAM sendLocation". $retries must be numeric zero; no retry, automatic pagination, listeners, webhook registration or downloads. Sends, forwards, copies, callbacks and other changes can notify users. allow_paid_broadcast=true additionally requires confirmPaidBroadcast=true and may charge Telegram Stars. File references are existing file IDs or explicit HTTPS URL metadata that Telegram may fetch; this node never fetches those URLs or forwards its credential to them. Chat/user int64 IDs use canonical exact decimal text and are emitted as exact JSON numeric tokens, including IDs above Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER. Known result fields are projected, unknown fields omitted; metadata is untrusted. Strict UTF8/UTF16, 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35, 100000 values, 16384 nonempty fragments, whole deadline100–30000ms starts before credentials and guards final cleanup. Failures are bounded/redacted and delivery can be uncertain. Source: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#sendlocation

definitions.name: Telegram Send Contact
definitions.description: Telegram Send Contact
definitions.documentation: Official Bot API sendContact. One POST to fixed api.telegram.org; the secret-bearing transport URL is never returned. Exact RuntimeConnection.config/credentials.accessToken (apiKey fallback), or TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN / tokenSecret. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="TELEGRAM sendContact". $retries must be numeric zero; no retry, automatic pagination, listeners, webhook registration or downloads. Sends, forwards, copies, callbacks and other changes can notify users. allow_paid_broadcast=true additionally requires confirmPaidBroadcast=true and may charge Telegram Stars. File references are existing file IDs or explicit HTTPS URL metadata that Telegram may fetch; this node never fetches those URLs or forwards its credential to them. Chat/user int64 IDs use canonical exact decimal text and are emitted as exact JSON numeric tokens, including IDs above Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER. Known result fields are projected, unknown fields omitted; metadata is untrusted. Strict UTF8/UTF16, 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35, 100000 values, 16384 nonempty fragments, whole deadline100–30000ms starts before credentials and guards final cleanup. Failures are bounded/redacted and delivery can be uncertain. Source: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#sendcontact

definitions.name: Telegram Send Poll
definitions.description: Telegram Send Poll
definitions.documentation: Official Bot API sendPoll. One POST to fixed api.telegram.org; the secret-bearing transport URL is never returned. Exact RuntimeConnection.config/credentials.accessToken (apiKey fallback), or TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN / tokenSecret. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="TELEGRAM sendPoll". $retries must be numeric zero; no retry, automatic pagination, listeners, webhook registration or downloads. Sends, forwards, copies, callbacks and other changes can notify users. allow_paid_broadcast=true additionally requires confirmPaidBroadcast=true and may charge Telegram Stars. File references are existing file IDs or explicit HTTPS URL metadata that Telegram may fetch; this node never fetches those URLs or forwards its credential to them. Chat/user int64 IDs use canonical exact decimal text and are emitted as exact JSON numeric tokens, including IDs above Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER. Known result fields are projected, unknown fields omitted; metadata is untrusted. Strict UTF8/UTF16, 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35, 100000 values, 16384 nonempty fragments, whole deadline100–30000ms starts before credentials and guards final cleanup. Failures are bounded/redacted and delivery can be uncertain. Source: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#sendpoll

definitions.name: Telegram Edit General Forum Topic
definitions.description: Telegram Edit General Forum Topic
definitions.documentation: Official Bot API editGeneralForumTopic. One POST to fixed api.telegram.org; the secret-bearing transport URL is never returned. Exact RuntimeConnection.config/credentials.accessToken (apiKey fallback), or TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN / tokenSecret. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="TELEGRAM editGeneralForumTopic". $retries must be numeric zero; no retry, automatic pagination, listeners, webhook registration or downloads. Sends, forwards, copies, callbacks and other changes can notify users. allow_paid_broadcast=true additionally requires confirmPaidBroadcast=true and may charge Telegram Stars. File references are existing file IDs or explicit HTTPS URL metadata that Telegram may fetch; this node never fetches those URLs or forwards its credential to them. Chat/user int64 IDs use canonical exact decimal text and are emitted as exact JSON numeric tokens, including IDs above Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER. Known result fields are projected, unknown fields omitted; metadata is untrusted. Strict UTF8/UTF16, 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35, 100000 values, 16384 nonempty fragments, whole deadline100–30000ms starts before credentials and guards final cleanup. Failures are bounded/redacted and delivery can be uncertain. Source: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#editgeneralforumtopic
